mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, store_id, code, name, time_zone_id, status, version, created_at, created_by_type, created_by_id, updated_at, updated_by_type, updated_by_id FROM store_location WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId, typeHandler=io.github.ande1922.moduvera.benchmark.store.candidate.TenantIdTypeHandler} AND store_id = #{storeId, typeHandler=io.github.ande1922.moduvera.benchmark.store.candidate.StoreIdTypeHandler}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_location ( tenant_id, store_id, code, name, time_zone_id, status, version, created_at, created_by_type, created_by_id, updated_at, updated_by_type, updated_by_id ) VALUES ( #{store.tenantId, typeHandler=io.github.ande1922.moduvera.benchmark.store.candidate.TenantIdTypeHandler}, #{store.id, typeHandler=io.github.ande1922.moduvera.benchmark.store.candidate.StoreIdTypeHandler}, #{store.code}, #{store.name}, #{store.timeZoneId}, #{store.status}, 0, #{auditAt, typeHandler=io.github.ande1922.moduvera.benchmark.store.candidate.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{actor.type}, #{actor.subjectId}, #{auditAt, typeHandler=io.github.ande1922.moduvera.benchmark.store.candidate.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{actor.type}, #{actor.subjectId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE store_location SET name = #{store.name}, status = #{store.status}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{auditAt, typeHandler=io.github.ande1922.moduvera.benchmark.store.candidate.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, updated_by_type = #{actor.type}, updated_by_id = #{actor.subjectId} WHERE tenant_id = #{store.tenantId, typeHandler=io.github.ande1922.moduvera.benchmark.store.candidate.TenantIdTypeHandler} AND store_id = #{store.id, typeHandler=io.github.ande1922.moduvera.benchmark.store.candidate.StoreIdTypeHandler} AND version = #{store.version} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
